newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF passes on 40,000T soymeal tenders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF passes on 40,000T soymeal tenders.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) said on Tuesday it had passed on tenders to buy 40,000 tonnes of soymeal because of higher-than-expected prices.
An NLCF official said arrival for the passed tenders had originally been slated for September 30 or October 20 to the ports of Inchon, Kunsan and Ulsan.

Shipment was set for August 25-September 13 for arrival by September 30 if sourced from India, or for July 28-August 16 if from South America. It was set for September 14-October 3 for arrival by October 20 if from India, or for August 17-September 5 if from South America.
Traders said the lowest offer was by Continental Grain at $295 a tonne C&F with Brazilian source for arrival by October 20. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5651
